opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Recently, the Hon'ble Supreme Court has made observation in the order dated 10.11.2023 passed in Writ Petition(s) (Criminal) No. 587 of 2023, titled Shaikh Uzma Feroz Hussain Vs. The State of Maharashtra that the constitutional court should not in a routine manner fix a time frame for a pending case before trial court for its conclusion in a specific time frame.
Thus, finding no exceptional ground, this Court is not inclined to exercise the inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
